guides.angle: How to clear the 50 Under the Bridge stunts in GTA 5 story mode on the way to 100%: what counts, what to fly, how to find the next bridge and the mistakes that waste time, from the owner's own run.
play_notes: TinoTV stream, 2 Nov 2026 (GTA V 100% run): playing as Franklin, he took a Buzzard Attack Chopper from a helipad at night and used it for the Under the Bridge stunts.
TinoTV stream, 2 Nov 2026: each counted pass puts an 'Under the Bridge' banner on screen with a running count; flying under the La Puerta Freeway showed 19 of 50 bridges flown under.
TinoTV stream, 2 Nov 2026: between bridges he opened the pause map to find the next one and set a waypoint, then flew low along the river channel and the freeways.
TinoTV stream, 2 Nov 2026: in heavy fog over the river channel and the hills the bridges were hard to see until close, so he flew slowly and low.
